potential_risk: Potential material misstatement or unsupported estimate; unusual size may warrant override testing.
evidence_to_request: Invoice or contract; purchase order; goods receipt or service acceptance; approval evidence; calculation supporting the amount.
audit_procedure: Agree amount to source documents and contract; assess business purpose and authorisation; compare with similar transactions and materiality.
scope_note: High amount is a dataset scenario, not proof of error or fraud.

potential_risk: Potential unsupported cash payment or misappropriation risk, particularly where cash controls are weak.
evidence_to_request: Cash voucher; receipt or invoice; petty-cash log; payment record; approval; reconciliation.
audit_procedure: Trace disbursement to evidence; verify recipient and business purpose; inspect approval and cash reconciliation.
scope_note: Do not infer missing approval unless records are inspected.

potential_risk: Potential cut-off error or delayed recording.
evidence_to_request: Source invoice; goods receipt/service date; posting record; explanation for delay.
audit_procedure: Compare document, posting and entry dates; assess correct accounting period and cut-off impact.
scope_note: Dataset threshold is 10–29 days; check available date fields.

potential_risk: Potential cut-off misstatement or late recognition; possible override requires corroboration.
evidence_to_request: Source invoice; contract; goods receipt/service evidence; posting record; subsequent payment or reversal; explanation.
audit_procedure: Reconstruct timeline; assess accounting period; inspect settlement/reversal; evaluate whether adjustment or expanded testing is needed.
scope_note: More than 29 days in the dataset; delay alone does not prove concealment.

potential_risk: Unusual posting activity; possible exceptional processing or weak review controls.
evidence_to_request: Entry timestamp; user activity log; approval trail if maintained; source document; access log.
audit_procedure: Confirm actual time and user; compare with entity procedures; inspect authorisation and support.
scope_note: Does not establish manual or unauthorised posting.

potential_risk: Unusual posting timing; possible exceptional processing.
evidence_to_request: Entry timestamp; user activity log; approval trail; source document; explanation for weekend processing.
audit_procedure: Verify date/time; establish whether weekend processing is normal; inspect approval and support.

potential_risk: Potential use of an unapproved bank account or misdirected funds.
evidence_to_request: Bank account master data; bank statement/confirmation; payment instruction; vendor/customer master change log; approval.
audit_procedure: Verify account against authorised bank records; trace to bank evidence; inspect creation/change history and approval.
scope_note: Must be independently verified; never infer from account code alone.

potential_risk: Potential unusual clearing relationship, misallocation or concealment of an open balance.
evidence_to_request: Invoices; credit notes; clearing documents; subledger; counterparty confirmation; reconciliation.
audit_procedure: Reconstruct the clearing chain; match amounts/dates/counterparties; inspect rationale and supporting documents.
scope_note: Cross-linking is not automatically a duplicate or misstatement.

potential_risk: Possible duplicate recording or repeated reference requiring investigation.
evidence_to_request: Source documents; invoice numbers; vendor/customer details; reversal records.
audit_procedure: Search exact and near-duplicate references; compare amounts, dates, counterparties and reversal history.
scope_note: Use only if duplicate-reference detection is independently implemented.

potential_risk: Possible misclassification or unexpected posting pattern.
evidence_to_request: Chart of accounts; accounting policy; source documents; comparable prior entries.
audit_procedure: Compare account combination with approved posting logic and similar transactions; inspect business rationale.
scope_note: Do not infer incorrect coding from an unfamiliar account signature alone.

potential_risk: Possible inappropriate access or segregation-of-duties concern.
evidence_to_request: User access matrix; activity logs; role/approval matrix; change logs.
audit_procedure: Compare activity with user role and historical baseline; inspect access rights and independent approval.
scope_note: User identity alone does not establish authorisation or wrongdoing.

potential_risk: Potential inability to substantiate occurrence, accuracy or business purpose.
evidence_to_request: Invoice/contract; purchase order; delivery/service evidence; payment proof; approval trail.
audit_procedure: Request documents and inspect completeness; if unavailable, document limitation and perform alternatives.
scope_note: Cannot be concluded from ledger data alone; requires document inspection.

potential_risk: Potential override of established controls or accounting estimates.
evidence_to_request: Journal approval trail; access logs; estimate support; board/audit committee records; source documents.
audit_procedure: Inspect unusual manual journals, approval exceptions and estimate changes; corroborate with independent evidence.
scope_note: Requires additional evidence; never infer override from a high score alone.
